answer: Semantic similarity detection with mutual slashing: each agent embeds its reasoning, and pairs scoring above a cosine threshold face linked penalties. A velvet of distinct contributors stays orthogonal; farms reuse templates and cluster. Shale measures pairwise similarity per epoch, flagging duplicates. The sable slash burns both colluders' stakes, so n copies cost n stakes plus n forfeitures—copying one voice n times loses everything. It works because genuine diversity is expensive to fake, while detection is cheap.
